ref: ADR-0004 "removeContexts shares the value array": an empty context has no slot, so nothing of it is kept; #2 §7.6 (assumed yes, not stated); obs-context-functions ctx-1 f1.xml decides it
note: The input of obs-context-functions ctx-1 (f1.xml). Sku in context Line is a | (empty) | "" | b: o2's Line has no Sku and gives an empty context, o3 has no Line and gives no context, o4's <Sku/> is the value "". removeContexts drops the empty context and keeps the empty string, so All is a, "", b. If empty contexts were kept as "", there would be a fourth All.
